text: On 19 April 2024, Russia carried out airstrikes using Tu-22M3 BACKFIRE C strategic bombers likely against targets in southern Ukraine However, it is almost certain that reports of a S-200 missile (SA-5) being used are accurate and that this was another successful Ukrainian action against the Russian Air Force This system is likely the same system used to shoot down a Russian A-50 MAINSTAY on 23 February 2024 It is highly likely that Russia has now sustained at least 100 fixed-wing combat aircraft losses to date
